**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives! LifeSTEPS is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services.**

We are seeking a highly motivated **Director of Social Services & Program Coordinator** who will:

* Empower low-income individuals and families to flourish by providing education and resources.
* Ensure our residents, specifically older adults to have an opportunity to thrive in place through housing and services.
* Encourage individuals and families through stable housing and supportive evidence-based services to build resilient communities.
* Maximize the strengths of individuals by providing client assistance, case management, service coordination and conducting community outreach.

**Additional duties will include:**

* Empowering children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing After School education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go to After School to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Job Specifics:**

* **Title:** Director of Social Services/Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, DSS 28 hrs per month & PC 10 hrs per week.
* **Job location:** Oakland, CA
* **Pay range:** $21.00- $28.35/hr

**More about us:**

The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **“Skills Training and Educational Programs”** and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by **LifeSTEPS** will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology or any related field.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing social services to multi-families, senior and children.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute for the degree
* A background or experience working for a non-profit would be a big plus!
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support people so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? **Apply today!!!**

jobs.description:
**Safety & Emergency Preparedness****Progra****m Manager**

  

**The Center for Elders' Independence**is a PACE (Program of All-Inclusive Care for the elderly) organization that uses an interdisciplinary team approach to care planning and care implementation for the purpose of providing high quality, affordable, integrated health care services to the elderly, including an Adult Day Health Center, and promoting autonomy, quality of life and the ability of individuals to live in their communities.

**The Position**: Under the direction of the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), the Safety & Emergency Preparedness, Program Manager is responsible for building, implementing, and continuously improving safety across all PACE care settings for participants, staff, visitors, volunteers and contracted providers. Specifically, this role will oversee initiatives across all CEI facilities including PACE center facilities, clinics, transportation, and home care. This role leads proactive hazard identification, incident response, and safety education, in alignment with OSHA, CMS, state, and local health and safety regulations. The Safety & Emergency Preparedness Program Manager champions a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the organization to support zero harm and high reliability.

The annual pay range for the Safety & Emergency Preparedness, Program Manager position at Center for Elders' Independence is $102,302 to $153,454. Placement within the range is determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data, consistent with CEI's annual compensation review and established compensation practices.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Collaborate with the CHRO and other leaders to identify, design, implement, and provide training on a standardized emergency management structure, such as the Hospital Incident Command System (HICS) or a protocol aligned with the National Incident Management System (NIMS), to ensure a coordinated and effective organizational response to emergencies.
* Ensure the effective deployment of emergency information through Everbridge.
* Lead the ongoing development, implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement of CEI's comprehensive Safety Program.
* Conduct regular Environment of Care (EOC) rounds, and other preparedness activities, across all PACE locations—clinical and non-clinical—to proactively identify and mitigate safety risks.
* Chair the Safety Committee and actively participate in other internal committees, contributing to ongoing audit preparedness (e.g., CMS, DHCS).
* Assess potential hazards to participants and staff and develop corrective action plans to address and prevent incidents.
* Establish and enforce safety policies and procedures that ensure full compliance with OSHA, CMS, DHCS, CDPH, and other relevant regulatory bodies.
* Investigate safety incidents, prepare detailed reports with findings and lead root cause analyses and corrective action planning.
* Use technology tools including incident reporting platform, audit checklists, CAP tracker, dashboard/BI tools, LMS training platforms, and document control software.
* Design and deliver engaging safety training programs for staff, covering topics such as infection control, hazard communication, emergency response, and incident command.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with departments to uphold safety standards across all care environments, including facilities, transportation, and home care.
* Direct the Emergency Preparedness Program, ensuring organizational readiness for a range of emergency scenarios.
* Maintain accurate documentation of safety audits, incident investigations, and regulatory inspections.

  

**REQUIRED** **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Health & Safety, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
* Minimum of three years' experience in healthcare safety, emergency management, or risk management.
* In-depth knowledge of OSHA, CMS, and state safety regulations, particularly in elder care or outpatient settings.
* Strong oral and written communication, training, and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with risk management principles and incident command systems.

  

**PREFERED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in a PACE organization, long-term care, or home health environment.
* Certified Healthcare Safety Professional (CHSP).
* OSHA 30-Hour – General Industry certification.

  

The above job description is intended to communicate the general function of the above-mentioned position and by no means shall be considered an exhaustive or complete outline of the specific tasks and functions that will be required. CEI reserves the right to change job descriptions, site assignments, and or work hours as required by the needs of the program. All employees are expected to perform their duties within their ability as required by the job and/or as requested by management.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Campfire**
------------------

Campfire is building modern accounting software for startups and mid-size tech companies, and we're going head to head with giants like NetSuite to do it. Our AI-native general ledger runs the close, revenue recognition, and reporting for finance teams that have outgrown QuickBooks and refuse to settle for a legacy ERP.

**The role**
------------

You'll own the business behind the business. You'll be the person leadership sends in on Campfire's highest-stakes problems, including ones nobody here has solved before. You'll get problems, not tasks, and you'll be expected to take them from "this is a mess" to "this runs itself." You'll work directly with every team at Campfire, and you'll have the authority to make decisions.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **The operating rhythm.** Help build and run the planning, goal-setting, and metrics cadence the company runs on. Make sure every team knows the number they own and whether they're hitting it.
* **The numbers leadership trusts.** Set the definitions for every core metric, then own the reporting for ARR, pipeline, bookings, retention, and spend. When the founders or the board ask a question, you have the answer, pulled straight from the raw data yourself.
* **Commercial contracts and vendors.** Run vendor negotiations and renewals, manage the contract lifecycle with legal, and make sure we never auto-renew something we don't need.
* **Sales and GTM operations.** Own CRM configuration, territory and quota planning, and the mechanics of how reps get paid. Make the sales team faster without letting the data get messy.
* **The company's infrastructure.** Insurance, office and real estate, compliance, and the systems that keep a growing company running. Nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.
* **Special projects that matter.** New market launches, partnerships, monetization and packaging work alongside our pricing lead, board prep. You'll take new initiatives from zero to one. When something important doesn't have an owner yet, it lands with you.
* **Automation over headcount.** If a process runs on spreadsheets and goodwill, rebuild it with code, AI, and the right tools so it scales without adding people.

**Who you are**
---------------

We care more about trajectory than pedigree. If you've owned hard problems end to end and have the results to show for it, we want to hear from you.

* **An owner, not a coordinator.** 2-4 years in business operations, top-tier consulting, banking, VC or PE, or founding a startup. You've been the person things roll up to.
* **Analytical to the core.** You're excellent in spreadsheets and you build models that hold up to scrutiny - you can tell the story behind the numbers.
* **AI-native in how you work.** You already use tools like Claude Code to automate work, build internal tools, and get more done than a team twice your size.
* **Commercially sharp.** You can read a contract, spot the bad clause, and negotiate a better deal with a vendor.
* **A clear communicator.** You can walk leadership or the board through a messy problem and leave them with a decision, and you're just as effective working alongside an AE or a support rep.
* **Relentless follow-through.** You close loops. When you say something will get done, it gets done, and people stop checking.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity.** Half of this job doesn't exist yet. You'll define it.

**Why this role**
-----------------

* **Direct line to leadership.** You work with leadership on decisions that move the business.
* **Breadth you won't find elsewhere.** Finance, sales, legal, and operations all cross your desk. It's a launchpad into leadership and the fastest path to running a business yourself.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

**Who we're looking for**

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Process Manager to shape how our go-to-market engine actually works.

In this role, you'll own the business processes, governance, and operating framework that powers our upper-funnel revenue engine. processes within our ABM tool 6sense. Your focus isn't on configuring the system; it's on defining how work should flow across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, so everything operates as one cohesive system. You will define how target accounts are identified, prioritized, routed, engaged, and progressed through the buyer journey using 6sense as a core component of our operating model.

You'll act as the bridge between business and technical teams, translating GTM strategy into clear, scalable process logic and requirements.

This is a process architecture role, not a systems administration role. Success isn't measured by tickets closed or configurations shipped; it is measured by clarity, scalability, adoption, and performance.

Your focus is not system administration or campaign execution. Instead, you'll design the business logic, workflows, decision frameworks, and governance that ensure our account-based strategy translates into consistent execution.

**What You Will Own**

**Design End to End GTM processes**

* Build and evolve workflows across Marketing, SDR, Sales, and Customer Success
* Ensure inbound, outbound, and account-based motions work together as a unified system
* Define lifecycle stages, ownership models, and clean handoffs across teams
* Design how target accounts move from identification through engagement, opportunity creation, and pipeline progression
* Establish account stages, buying stages, ownership models, and engagement plays
* Ensure inbound, outbound, and ABM motions operate as a coordinated system rather than independent workflows

**Translate Strategy into Execution**

* Translate GTM strategy into:
  + Process flows
  + Decision logic
  + Business requirements
  + Acceptance criteria
* Partner closely with CRM and Systems teams, acting as the primary interface with GTM stakeholders
* Ensure implementations reflect business intent (not just technical feasibility)

**Own Process Governance & Data Clarity**

* Define and enforce:
  + Source-of-truth definitions
  + Data ownership models
  + Process standards across systems
* Create clear, human-readable documentation so teams understand how things work

**Define routing, prioritization, and signals**

* Design lead, account, and opportunity routing strategies
* Build prioritization frameworks based on segmentation and signals
* Eliminate gaps, duplication, and conflicting engagement paths

**Drive Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Define SLAs, KPIs, thresholds, and success criteria across GTM motions
* Design and deliver high quality process training to drive GTM team members to optimize day to day activities
* Monitor process health (e.g., coverage, routing accuracy, adoption)
* Continuously iterate as GTM strategy, segments, and tooling evolve

**What Success Looks Like**

* GTM processes are clearly defined, consistently executed, and widely adopted
* Stakeholders understand how the system works without relying on tribal knowledge
* Salesforce reflects intentional design, not incremental patchwork
* Process changes are scalable, testable, and measurable
* Business and systems teams operate with shared clarity and alignment

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a Salesforce Administrator — does not own configuration or system builds
* Not a Marketo / campaign execution role
* Not a reporting or analytics-only function
* Not a ticket-based support role for CRM requests

**What** **We're** **Looking For**

* 5+ years in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, or Sales/Marketing Operations
* High learning agility and analytical thinking
* Proven ownership of lead management, routing, or demand processes in complex GTM environments
* Experience working across Sales, Marketing, SDR, and Systems teams
* Exposure to ABM tools like 6sense
* Exposure to different revenue intelligence tools, such as Marketo, Groove, Dialpad and Gong
* Proven experience operating in a scaled B2B organization (SaaS or complex GTM preferred)
* Process-first thinker — designs for clarity, scalability, and real-world usability
* Exceptional written communicator — translates complexity into clear logic and specs
* Systems translator — bridges business needs and technical implementation seamlessly
* Structured problem solver — brings order to ambiguity and incomplete inputs
* Influencer without authority — earns trust across senior GTM and technical stakeholders
* Detail-oriented but outcome-driven — balances precision with business impact

**Compensation:**

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors such as your skills, qualifications and experience. Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more.

The Partner Operations Manager will build the operational foundation that enables Happen’s personal loan partnerships to launch, scale, and perform reliably. You’ll bring structure to complex cross-functional work across Product, Engineering, Credit, Risk, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Marketing, and Analytics, creating the workflows, governance, and visibility that keep partner initiatives moving. Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description**

Turner & Townsend is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and business-focused **Executive Assistant & Operations Manager** to support senior leadership while overseeing key operational, governance, compliance, and administrative functions across the business.

This role serves as a trusted partner to leadership, ensuring priorities are effectively managed, business operations run efficiently, and governance, risk, and client care activities are coordinated and tracked.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Executive Support**

* Provide proactive administrative support to senior leadership, including complex calendar management, meeting coordination, and travel planning.
* Anticipate priorities, identify potential issues, and take action to ensure effective execution of leadership objectives.
* Prepare briefing materials, presentations, reports, and executive communications.
* Plan and coordinate leadership, management, governance, and board meetings.
* Develop agendas, meeting materials, decision logs, action registers, and follow-up reports.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements and itineraries.
* Manage confidential and sensitive business information with discretion and professionalism.
* Serve as a key point of contact between leadership and internal and external stakeholders.

**Operations & Business Management**

* Coordinate operational activities to support business priorities and strategic objectives.
* Establish and maintain operational processes, procedures, and documentation.
* Track strategic initiatives, actions, and leadership commitments to ensure timely completion.
* Maintain operational records and reporting systems.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, trackers, and reporting tools for leadership teams.
* Produce regular reports related to operational performance, compliance activities, risk management, governance actions, and client care initiatives.
* Coordinate client care and satisfaction tracking activities.
* Maintain client action logs and monitor follow-through on commitments and improvement actions.

**Governance, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Maintain oversight of action items and accountability tracking across leadership teams.
* Support annual planning cycles, business reviews, and strategic planning activities.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of compliance programs, internal controls, and business policies.
* Maintain risk registers and monitor mitigation actions in partnership with leadership teams.
* Assist with audit preparation, policy reviews, governance reporting requirements, and business continuity activities.
* Monitor business risks, issues, and escalation items, ensuring appropriate visibility and follow-through.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, regulatory requirements, and client governance expectations.

**Qualifications**  

* Minimum of 5 years' experience supporting senior executives, business leaders, or operational functions.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating governance, compliance, risk management, or business operations activities.
* Exceptional organizational, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Technology Enablement Program Manager
jobs.description:
Meta is searching for an experienced Program Manager to join our Tech Design and Enablement team. This is a pivotal role for a transformation leader who can drive enterprise-wide sourcing transformation initiatives. As an AI-native company, Meta is looking for someone who can think strategically about how to leverage AI—not just using it for the sake of it, but applying it with intent to drive real, measurable impact across our sourcing programs. This role will be responsible for architecting enterprise-wide sourcing programs that redefine how Meta manages its global sourcing ecosystem. Working at the intersection of Strategic Sourcing, Finance, and Enterprise Products, you will drive the strategy, product roadmap, governance, and metrics for our most critical technology initiatives. We are looking for someone who can navigate ambiguity, design scalable and resource-optimized solutions, and apply a strategic lens to how AI and automation can accelerate outcomes across strategic sourcing workflows  
  
  

### **Technology Enablement Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Architect and deliver the end-to-end strategy for key strategic programs that directly support the shift toward autonomous, AI-driven buying
* Shape the multi-year vision for key sourcing programs - proactively identifying emerging opportunities and risks, developing original strategic recommendations, and translating these into actionable roadmaps with clear milestones using a data-driven approach
* Take ownership of multiple, multi-layered cross-functional relationships. Proactively and strategically engage cross-functional stakeholders to drive the adoption of technology programs, processes, and tools
* Drive the evolution of Meta's sourcing ecosystem by spearheading cross-functional engagement and change initiatives that bridge organizational silos, while owning the long-term roadmap for process optimization
* Serve as a strategic thought partner to the Tech Enablement lead - proactively analyzing market trends, sourcing landscape shifts, and internal data to surface insights and propose new strategic directions for sourcing programs
* Deploy advanced data tools and analytical techniques to measure program performance and provide actionable insights for executive decision-making
* Define, track, and report on program success metrics, ensuring clear visibility into ROI and business impact of key strategy initiatives and reporting outcomes to leadership
* Operate with a high degree of independence — proactively identifying what needs to happen next, bringing forward ideas and recommendations, and maintaining momentum on key initiatives

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of professional experience in strategic sourcing or a related field, with deep hands-on experience in technology and data-driven transformation or enterprise systems implementation
* Experience applying data analytical techniques to inform design decisions, developing fact-based success metrics, and continuously training data models and demonstrated experience incorporating data into design decisions, developing fact-based success metrics and continuously training data models
* Experience driving end-to-end process improvements and continuous improvement cycles in a global, time-sensitive corporate environment

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* A self-directing work style with evidence of proactively advancing projects, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and bringing forward ideas and proposals without being asked
* Demonstrated experience of operating with high autonomy - someone who is energized by the absence of explicit instruction
* Proven track record of navigating complex, fast-changing environments where the requirements are fluid
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated experience of moving projects forward by making high-judgment decisions with incomplete information and building consensus across stakeholders
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated experience of developing and executing long-term strategic plans that resulted in measurable business transformation
* Demonstrated experience of actively upskilling and experimenting with new tools and technologies, including exploring how AI can transform sourcing workflows
* Experience with enterprise procurement systems and the implementation of sourcing-related technology solutions
* In-depth knowledge across strategic sourcing, programme management, and procurement transformation. While extensive strategic sourcing experience is essential, candidates who can demonstrate meaningful experience across all three will stand out
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Proven communication skills with a demonstrated track record of leading change management efforts and overcoming operational barriers to adoption
* High integrity, with a track record of building trust and operating transparently across teams and stakeholders

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Candidates must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the communities served by Travis Credit Union, which include the following counties: Alameda, Colusa, Contra Costa, Merced, Napa, Placer, Sacramento, San Joaquin, Solano, Sonoma, Stanislaus, and Yolo. This role focuses on integrating member and organizational intelligence, facilitating prioritization and governance processes, and ensuring insights are translated into coordinated actions that improve member experience and support organizational objectives.

By enabling informed decision-making, accountability, and cross-functional alignment, the Member Experience Program Manager contributes to the advancement of TCU's Member Experience strategy and continuous improvement efforts. This role helps strengthen member financial wellbeing, relationship health, and the delivery of TCU's Stellar Member Experience.

* Facilitates prioritization processes that balance member impact, financial wellbeing, organizational risk, business value, and strategic alignment.
* Establishes and maintains governance processes, accountability mechanisms, and reporting structures that support effective execution and organizational transparency.
* Coordinates cross-functional action planning and monitors progress to ensure improvement initiatives deliver measurable results.
* Develops executive dashboards, reporting, and decision-support materials that provide visibility into priorities, performance, and outcomes.
* Partners with leaders across the organization to align member experience priorities with business objectives and improvement initiatives.
* Oversees the optimization and effective use of listening technologies, survey platforms, vendors, and experience-management tools.
* Contributes to the advancement of Member Experience strategy, operating practices, governance standards, and capability maturity.

  

Not all functions/tasks are listed above; however, those listed are considered essential.

* Governance & Operating Model Stewardship.
* Stakeholder Influence & Alignment.
* Strategic Thinking & Decision Enablement.
* Prioritization & Action Planning.
* Executive Communication & Storytelling.
* Cross-Functional Partnership & Influence.
* Member Intelligence & Experience Management.
* Continuous Improvement & Change Management.
* Vendor & Technology Relationship Management.
* Organizational Planning & Accountability.

  

**Reporting and Experience:**

**Member Experience Program Manager:**

* Reports directly to assigned department leadership.
* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communications, organizational leadership, customer experience, project management, data analytics, or related field; or an advanced degree without experience; or equivalent related work experience.
* Minimum of 2 years of related experience.
* Experience supporting governance, reporting, accountability, prioritization, or organizational improvement activities.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate stakeholders and facilitate execution of cross-functional initiatives.

  

**Sr. Member Experience Program Manager:**

* Reports directly to assigned department leadership.
* Bachelor's degree in business, communications, organizational leadership, customer experience, project management, analytics, or related field; or a master's degree and 3 years of related experience; or equivalent related work experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of related experience.
* Advanced knowledge of Member Intelligence, Voice of the Member (VoM), governance practices, prioritization methodologies, and continuous improvement principles.
* Demonstrated experience facilitating cross-functional initiatives, governance processes, and organizational change efforts.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influence skills.

**Compensation:** **Base salary starting range is commensurate with experience:**

* **Member Experience Program Manager:** Grade 16: $90,084.80/annually -$111,280.00/annually
* **Sr. Member Experience Program Manager:** Grade 18: $107,016.00/annually -$132,204.80/annually
  

**Benefits:**

At Travis Credit Union, we prioritize the well‑being of our employees and their families by providing a comprehensive Total Rewards program that supports their health, welfare, and financial security. In turn, this enables our employees to focus on delivering exceptional service to our members and meeting the goals of the credit union.

Eligible employees enjoy a robust benefits package, which includes:

* Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Mental health and wellness programs
* Employee performance incentive plan
* Merit-based salary increases
* 401(k) program with immediately vested employer match

* Exclusive TCU perks such as employee loan and credit card discounts

**This is a Stanford Health Care job.**

As a **Space Planner** within the Facilities Planning & Design (FPD) business unit at Stanford Health Care Facilities Services, you will play a critical role in shaping and optimizing the environments that support patient care, clinical operations, and administrative functions across the organization. Acting as both a strategic consultant and project manager, you'll partner with department leaders, clinicians, facilities teams, and executive stakeholders to evaluate space needs, analyze utilization, and develop creative solutions that align with operational goals, growth initiatives, and organizational priorities. You'll manage multiple space planning initiatives simultaneously, conduct assessments and feasibility analyses, develop recommendations, present solutions to leadership, and coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution. The role ensures timely communication, accurate documentation, and coordination across departments to support safe, efficient, and standards‑driven test fits. Recognized as a Best Place to Work in the Bay Area by the **San Francisco Business Times** and the **Silicon Valley Business Journal** every year since 2011, Syserco attracts and retains exceptional people.

We invest in our employees, supporting them on the job, at home, and as they plan for their families and futures. We build collaborative workplaces, stay active in our communities, embrace work-life balance, and believe a fun-filled workplace yields the best results.

**The opportunity**
-------------------

As a **Project Manager at Syserco** , you will lead HVAC controls and construction projects from engineering and procurement through installation, startup, commissioning, and closeout.

You will guide project teams, resolve scope-related challenges, and serve as the customer’s primary point of contact. You will also own project financial performance, balancing budgets, labor, billing, and cash flow to deliver profitable projects and an exceptional customer experience.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Oversee project deliverables and contractual obligations from engineering and procurement through installation and closeout. Resolve scope-of-work issues across projects of varying size and complexity.

You’ll work between strategy and execution, bringing Product Marketing, Product Management, Sales, and Corporate Marketing together around one integrated plan, and keeping everyone moving in the same direction.

* Launches and GTM initiatives reach the market on schedule, and Sales and partners are ready on day one.
* Stakeholders have one source of truth and get no surprises.
* The launch process gets measurably faster and more consistent over time.
* Strategic and org-wide initiatives move from idea to adoption, with clear owners, measurable outcomes, and executive visibility.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

What you bring

* 12+ years of experience in program management, with significant time spent on B2B go-to-market or product launch programs.
* A track record of leading complex, cross-functional programs with many workstreams running at once.
* Experience driving initiatives that span multiple teams or the whole organization, including change management and executive stakeholder alignment.
* An understanding of how product marketing, sales enablement, and field readiness fit together.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Excellent facilitation skills, including running planning sessions, working sessions, and decision-making forums with cross-functional leaders.

* Curiosity and the ability to pick up new technologies and markets quickly.

Nice to have

* Experience in enterprise infrastructure, cloud, data, or storage.
* PMP, PgMP, or Agile certification.

Education
  
A bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a technical field, or equivalent experience. A master’s degree may substitute for some of the required experience.

Our purpose – Opening up a world of opportunity – explains why we exist. Here at HSBC we use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth and perspectives to open up new kinds of opportunity for our more than 40 million customers. We’re bringing together the people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world – for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities and the planet we all share.

This role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical implementation, and project delivery for HSBC’s client connectivity channels. You’ll run technical discovery and client workshops, convert business outcomes into technical designs, define testing and cutover approaches (including ISO 20022 formats and SWIFT migration considerations), and then drive end-to-end execution—removing blockers across client teams, Product, IT, Client Service and Coverage/Sales. The goal: faster time-to-revenue, high-quality implementations, and smooth client experience.

As our Sr Project Manager, Client Connectivity-Innovation Banking, you will:

* Own the end-to-end technical approach for client connectivity implementations, including architecture decisions, sequencing, and technical artefacts
* Lead technical client workshops to document current-state processes and define target-state automation across:
* + Accounts Payable, Receivables, Treasury, Payroll
  + Bank statements and technical reconciliation
* Design connectivity solutions across:
* + APIs, SWIFT connectivity (connected banking patterns, security considerations, technical trade-offs)
  + H2H/file-based connectivity (format management, transmission patterns, operational controls) and HSBCnet channel alignment as required
* Translate client requirements into clear technical deliverables (data mapping, message specifications, control points, exception handling)
* Document agreed solutions clearly, including statements of work, technical scope, assumptions, dependencies, and controls
* Lead practical implementation of ISO 20022 for payments and reporting message formats, including mapping, validation, and exception handling
* Ensure solution designs account for industry evolution, including SWIFT MT to MX migration impacts and de-risking plans for corporate clients

* Lead end-to-end delivery: planning, execution and cutover, with a strong emphasis on technical risk control

* Act as a trusted advisor to client technology and treasury stakeholders—confidently leading workshops and senior stakeholder discussions

* Deep experience in client-facing solutioning and technical delivery: solution architecture, implementation, or technical consulting within banking/payments/treasury/fintech
* Hands-on delivery of connectivity implementations using H2H/file-based and/or API-based technical; able to clearly explain trade-offs and fit-for-purpose recommendations

jobs.title: SOCIAL SERVICES CARE COORDINATOR-BILINGUAL
jobs.description:
**ORGANIZATION**

The mission of Ravenswood Family Health Network (RFHN) is to improve the health of the community by providing culturally sensitive, integrated primary and preventative health care to all, regardless of ability to pay or immigration status, and collaborating with community partners to address the social determinants of health.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Social Services Care Coordinator provides care coordination to patients served through the Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) and Health Care for the Homeless (HCH) programs and ECM programs. Under the direction of the Department Manager of Social Services, and in collaboration with the Senior Manager of Social Services and HCH Program Manager, the Coordinator supports patients experiencing homelessness, housing instability, alcohol dependence, and complex medical and social needs.

The Coordinator manages an active caseload of approximately 35 patients, completing assessments, developing care plans, coordinating services, conducting outreach, and connecting patients to healthcare, housing, benefits, and other community resources. The Coordinator works closely with the MAT and HCH teams to address barriers to care and social determinants of health while promoting patient engagement, self-advocacy, and independence.

The position utilizes trauma-informed, culturally responsive, patient-centered, motivational interviewing, and harm-reduction approaches and collaborates with internal teams and community partners to support coordinated care and improved patient outcomes.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*To be performed in accordance with RFHN Policies and Procedures*

* Serves as the primary contact to assigned social services members and advocates to help them navigate the healthcare system.
* Maintains an active caseload of approximately 35+ patients, providing ongoing social services care coordination based on patient needs, acuity, and program requirements.
* Completes comprehensive social service, psychosocial, and social determinants of health assessments to identify patient needs, strengths, barriers, risks, and available support systems.
* Develops individualized care plans in collaboration with patients, the MAT treatment team, Health Care for the Homeless (HCH) Program Manager, Senior Manager of Social Services, medical providers, behavioral health staff, and other members of the care team.
* Provides care coordination to patients participating in the Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) program with a focus on alcohol dependence, supporting engagement in treatment and continuity of care.
* Identifies ECM eligible candidates and refers them to Program Associate and covers for ECM cases as needed.
* Works collaboratively with the Health Care for the Homeless program to address the unique healthcare and social service needs of patients experiencing homelessness or housing instability.
* Provides patient outreach and engagement in clinic and community settings, including shelters, housing programs, and other locations where patients may be accessing services.
* Educates patients about housing resources, eligibility requirements, housing navigation processes, and available supportive housing and homeless services.
* Connects patients to appropriate housing resources, emergency shelter, transitional housing, permanent supportive housing, coordinated entry, and other community-based services.
* Identifies and coordinates referrals addressing social determinants of health, including housing, food insecurity, transportation, income, benefits, employment, legal services, behavioral health, alcohol dependence treatment, and other identified needs.
* Assists patients with accessing public benefits and supportive services, including SSI/SSDI, CalFresh, cash assistance, health insurance, and other available benefits.
* Assists patients with obtaining documents necessary to access housing, benefits, healthcare, and other services, including identification, birth certificates, financial documentation, and other required records.
* Supports patients with scheduling appointments, appointment reminders, transportation coordination, referrals, and other activities designed to reduce barriers to healthcare and treatment.
* Coordinates referrals and follows up with patients and service providers to promote successful connection to recommended services.
* Provides support during transitions of care, including hospital discharge, emergency department visits, residential treatment, alcohol dependence treatment, and transitions between healthcare and community-based services.
* Uses trauma-informed, culturally responsive, patient-centered, motivational interviewing, and harm-reduction approaches when working with patients.
* Educates and supports patients in developing self-advocacy, self-management, and independent skills to navigate healthcare, housing, and social service systems.
* Advocates for patients and assists in resolving barriers to healthcare, treatment, housing, benefits, and other needed services.
* Maintains regular communication with patients and, when authorized, family members, caregivers, guardians, or other identified support persons.
* Participates in interdisciplinary case conferences and collaborates with the Manager of Social Services, Senior Manager of Social Services, HCH Program Manager, MAT treatment team, medical providers, behavioral health staff, and community partners to coordinate patient care.
* Maintains timely, accurate, and complete documentation of assessments, care plans, patient contacts, referrals, interventions, and outcomes in Epic and other required systems.
* Maintains documentation and data necessary to meet RFHN, program, county, state, federal, health plan, and funding requirements.
* Identifies urgent or high-risk patient needs and promptly communicates concerns to the Manager of Social Services, Senior Manager of Social Services, HCH Program Manager, and/or appropriate clinical team member

The six core components of clinical case management include: processes and relationships, health care management, community resources and support, service delivery, psychosocial intervention; and rehabilitation case management. jobs.title: Program Manager, Services
jobs.description:
**About Abode:**

When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.

At Abode, we believe everyone deserves a safe and stable place to call home. Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths.

**Housing Ends Homelessness**

**Our Mission:**

Abode works to end homelessness by assisting low-income, unhoused people, including those with special needs, to secure stable, supportive housing; and to be advocates for the removal of the causes of homelessness.

**Our Values:**

* Start with Dignity
* Take Smart Risks
* Be transparent
* Solve for today and tomorrow
* Spark each other’s strengths

**About The Role**:

The Program Manager will provide leadership, support, and oversight to a multidisciplinary team to assist adults and their families who are homeless and/or formerly homeless. This team will engage, and support participants maintaining housing /shelter placement, develop and execute housing stability plans and provide wraparound supportive services. Key responsibilities include supervision of staff and oversight of services delivery, close coordination with case management partners and budget and oversight of public contracts.

**How You Make An Impact**:

* Provide direct supervision to all Program staff and interns.
* Provide regular and appropriate feedback including training, opportunities for professional growth, verbal, and written improvement plans when needed, and regular evaluations.
* Ensure that all program staff under your leadership are meeting the goals as set forth in their program’s respective grants.
* Coordinate training, schedules, caseloads, vacations, and assignments as part of program administration.
* Provide support to staff when dealing with client crises, problem solving with managers on challenging participant situations, and develop on-going housing stability interventions with staff.
* Build collaborative relationships with property management and on-site resident services staff if applicable. Advocate for participants housed at various sites as needed.
* Supervise staff and provide feedback, coaching, training, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Work with staff to ensure timely and accurate data entry is occurring.
* Work with Data Specialists on reporting to funders and stakeholders on program activities.
* Monitor Programs contracts to ensure maximization of funding and program deliverables are met and support with program audits.
* Assist in developing policy and procedures and other aspects of programs.
* Facilitate case conferencing and administrative meetings.
* Assist in developing materials, assessment tools, job descriptions, and other program processes/documents/tools.
* Other duties as assigned.

**How You Meet Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in psychology, Human Services, Social Work, Sociology, or related field or equivalent experience.
* 3 years of professional experience in the human services, social work, or related field and demonstrated experience working collaboratively with low-income families and providing service coordination.
* 2 years of direct experience in the provision and supervision of case management services to individuals who are homeless and/or have extremely low incomes.
* Use of personal vehicle and proof of a valid and current California Driver’s License and current insurance along with a clean DMV record required.

**Our Benefits and Perks:**

* **Competitive pay:** $75,000 - $92,000 annually
* **Work arrangement**: Onsite position; may be eligible for hybrid or remote work, subject to supervisor approval and factors including job responsibilities, remote location, and employee suitability.
* **PTO:**19 days per year, increasing with tenure
* **Holidays:** 12 paid holidays per year
* **Health & Wellness:**
  + 100% medical, dental and vision coverage options for employees
  + Employer subsidized options for dependent health care."
  + Legal and financial services and more through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  + Mental health care service provided by Teledoc
  + Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
    - Commuter
    - Health care
    - Dependent care
  + **Retirement Plan:** 403(b) w/ employer match & contribution programs

**Notice**: Abode Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace.

#### **Education**

Required

* Bachelors or better in Human Services
* Bachelors or better in Social Work
* Bachelors or better in Psychology
* Bachelors or better in Sociology

jobs.title: Benefits Case Manager
jobs.description:
**BENEFITS CASE MANAGER**

**The Center for Elders' Independence (CEI)** provides a Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (P.A.C.E.) - a comprehensive healthcare model specifically designed for low-income, frail seniors. It combines medical and social services along with vigilant care planning and coordination in order to keep frail seniors safely living at home and in their communities. This unique and highly effective model utilizes an interdisciplinary team approach to care planning to drive high quality, affordable, integrated healthcare services to the elderly.

**Position****:** Under the supervision of Director of Enrollment and Member Services, the Benefits Case Manager ensures that all CEI participants are enrolled in all income and insurance benefits that they are eligible for. Benefits Case Manager will be required to work effectively with participants, participant families, representative payees and relevant government agencies to proactively maintain and address benefit eligibility issues that arise as well as support different prospect/participant benefit related projects within the agency.

The hourly pay range for the Benefits Case Manager position at Center for Elders' Independence is $26.25 to $39.38. Placement within the range is determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data, consistent with CEI's annual compensation review and established compensation practices.

  

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Department and Caseload Management**

* Benefits Case Manager keeps track and ensures that all participants' benefits eligibility needs are met; this includes working directly with the participants, participant families, representative payees and the relevant government agencies to proactively maintain benefit eligibility and resolve all eligibility issues that arise.
* Manages the assigned participant eligibility caseload which includes attending enrollment, care conference meetings and conducting home visits with participants where eligibility issues need to be addressed.
* Manages the caseload information on participants in a well-organized and secure filing system as devised by the department.
* Keeps track and monitors the eligibility status of the participant assigned to the caseload and generates regular reports as needed.

  

**Income Benefits**

* Ensures that the CEI participants' income information assigned to the caseload is known and verified at all times and is well documented in the CEI database.
* Ensures that accurate share-of-cost information is gathered, well documented and communicated with the participant on the caseload and the finance staff in an effective and in a timely fashion to enable CEI to collect share-of-cost revenue.
* Works with the participants, families and social workers connected to the assigned caseload to ensure that the Board and Care and SNF income level changes are made by the social security administration, that all involved understand the changes and that the benefit levels are accurate on all Board and Care documents.
* Communicates income issues to social work, finance, member services and other pertinent staff as needed affiliated with the participant on the caseload to ensure interdepartmental effectiveness.

  

**Insurance Benefits**

* Ensures that all CEI participants' benefit information on the assigned caseload is known and verified at all times and well documented in the CEI database.
* Ensures that CEI participants who are assigned to the caseload are fully enrolled in Medi-Cal and any Medicare benefits they are eligible for prior to enrollment and following enrollment (ie assist with getting participants who are Medi-Cal only qualify for Medicare and participant missing Medicare Part A qualified for QMB benefit to obtain Part A coverage).
* Manages Medi-Cal re-certification to ensure that eligibility is maintained for all participants and facilitate proper communication and documents if retro payment request needs to be processed for month reflecting no payment code.
* Verify IHSS enrollment information prior to enrollment and document in CEI database for proper termination after enrollment.
* Communicates insurance issues to social worker, finance, member services and other pertinent staff as needed affiliated with the participant on the caseload to sure interdepartmental effectiveness.

  

**Relevant Skills and Experience:**

* High School diploma required.
* Experience or knowledge in benefit such as Medi-Cal, Medicare and other common benefits available for seniors.
* Excellent customer service and service recovery skills.
* Strong case management skills. Ability to work closely with cross-functional team members including Outreach and Enrollment staff and IDT staff at the PACE centers.
* A demonstrated history of success in goal attainment.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both oral and written.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We're hiring our first Global Account Managers to own and aggressively grow a small number of our largest global accounts — companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce.

Accounts of this scale are not one company; they're dozens. Amazon alone runs research across retail, devices, AWS, advertising, and entertainment, in a dozen countries, with separate budgets and separate buying centers in each. We're already inside these organizations and the teams who use us love us. What we don't yet have is someone whose entire job is to turn a strong foothold into an enterprise-wide standard. That's this role.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales. You'll carry full commercial ownership of your accounts — expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal — and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You will not be working a wide territory or chasing net-new logos. You'll be going deep in a handful of the most important companies in the world, finding net new buying centers and getting introduced via referrals, building the relationships and the multi-year plan that make Outset the way they understand their customers.

You'll do it with a team around you. Each global account is supported by a dedicated account team — Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team. You set the strategy and direct the effort; the resources are there to execute it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own a portfolio of a small number of strategic global accounts — companies on the scale of Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce — with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.
* Find new buying centers, both regionally and within the larger umbrella brand, to pursue, predominantly via deep account understanding, referrals and in-person visits.
* Carry and exceed an aggressive seven-figure growth target across that portfolio.
* Build and maintain a live global account plan for each logo: every buying center by business unit, region, and research function; whitespace and spend map; executive relationship map; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Multi-thread relentlessly — from practicing researchers to VPs to the C-suite — and build senior relationships durable enough to survive champion turnover, reorgs, and procurement cycles.
* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors), setting priorities and holding the plan together across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that reframe the relationship around business outcomes, not usage stats, and convert them into committed budgets.
* Negotiate and close complex enterprise agreements — global MSAs, enterprise-wide and multi-region commitments, multi-year structures, enterprise procurement, security and privacy review — in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.
* Coordinate coverage globally, aligning our regional teams behind a single account strategy rather than a set of local ones.
* Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.
* Bring the voice of your accounts back into Outset — informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion itself.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years in enterprise sales, including 5+ years in a named global or strategic account role (Global Account Manager, Global Account Director, Strategic Account Manager, or equivalent) owning a small book of major brands.
* Direct experience selling into and growing accounts of this profile — large, global, matrixed technology or consumer organizations with many buying centers, such as Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, or Salesforce.
* A proven record of exceeding aggressive seven-figure growth targets *inside existing accounts* — expansion, cross-sell, and renewal — not only net-new logo attainment.
* World-class relationship management. You are known for the depth and durability of the relationships you build, and you can point to accounts you grew over years, not quarters.
* Executive presence and commercial sharpness: credible with CxO and VP-level buyers, consultative enough to teach and shape their thinking, and comfortable negotiating at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead an extended, cross-functional account team without direct authority — you make the people around you more effective on your accounts.
* Experience navigating complex global commercial structures: multi-region contracting, enterprise procurement, multi-year commitments, and competing internal stakeholders.
* Operational rigor — a real account planning methodology, accurate forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* High ownership, opinionated, proactive, and comfortable with a very fast pace of both decision-making and execution in a startup that is still building the playbook.

jobs.title: OG.com - Senior Product Manager - Fiat Onboarding
jobs.description:
### **About Us**

  

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.

### **Role Overview**

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own how money and identity get into OG: signup, KYC, fiat funding, payouts, and the funding experience behind all of it. Fans can’t trade until they can fund, so every drop-off in onboarding or funding costs us volume, trust, and share of wallet.

Your job is to make funded accounts fast and trustworthy, with a design bar you won’t lower. You’ll own the path from signup through KYC and funding to a trade-ready account: the funding methods that actually clear, the failure states that quietly kill conversion, and the feedback loops that move the funnel. Trading surfaces like markets, parlays, and live sit with a partner PM. The front door is yours.

The funding product is yours end to end, including funding methods, limits, retries, risk configuration, and partner UX. You won’t be negotiating bank charters. You’ll be deciding what ships, when, and at what balance of friction against compliance. You’ll report to the VP of Product, who sets strategy across Financial Services while you own the how and the when for OG.com.

### **What You'll Actually Do:**

* **Own onboarding and funding end to end.** Signup, verify, deposit, time-to-funded. You make the call on where to trade friction for compliance. The job isn’t shipping a KYC screen; it’s getting people from signup to funded to ready for their first trade.
* **Own the funding product.** You decide funding methods, payouts, limits, retries, and partner UX, spanning ACH, cards, instant funding, and whatever else clears in the U.S. Authorization and flow of funds are product decisions to you, not a ticket you file with a vendor.
* **Treat the money-in funnel as a growth surface.** You instrument the drop-off, go after the leaks, and sequence your work against conversion. On the handoff from funded to first contract, you partner with the Predictions PM.
* **Hold the design bar on trust and money UX.** Clarity, hierarchy, and clean error states aren’t negotiable. When someone’s entering a debit card or waiting on an ACH, “good enough” doesn’t cut it, and you’ll say so. Your feedback is specific: interaction cost, copy, recovery paths, not vibes.
* **Wireframe and partner on design.** You build your own wires and drive the design conversation, catching the clunky funding and KYC moments before users hit them.
* **Talk to users like a peer.** You run research on how people really sign up, verify, and move money. You ask them to show you how they fund an account instead of asking whether they’d use instant deposit.
* **Drive cross-functional execution.** You get engineering, design, data, compliance, payments, and ops working toward the same funded-user outcomes. Nothing in onboarding or funding ships without your sign-off on the product and UX bar.

### **Requirements:**

* **Consumer money-in funnel ownership.** You’ve owned a consumer signup-to-deposit-to-funded flow, and you can walk us through the funnel you ran, the drop-offs you went after, and the number that actually moved. That’s the bar. Merchant acquiring, B2B payouts, and adjacent-team contributions don’t count.
* **Hands-on flow-of-funds ownership at the bank-API layer, not just a gateway.** You’ve done real work integrating bank or embedded-banking APIs, whether direct bank and partner-bank APIs or a banking-as-a-service or rails provider, and you’ve owned a funding method, rail, or failure mode end to end. You can point to a specific flow of funds or failure state you ran yourself: a settlement failure, an ACH return or NACHA edge case, a retry model, a routing decision, a chargeback or liability flow. You don’t need to have built a bank core from scratch, but consuming a payment gateway and filing tickets against it won’t clear this bar. The judgment we need comes from having worked at the money layer, so you’re making sound calls on day one.
* **Design sensibility as a product skill.** You can critique money-in and identity UX with specifics like hierarchy, density, recovery, and trust, not just “it looks nicer.” Tell us about a flow you refused to ship until it was clear.
* **An instinct for why funding has to feel instant.** In a live-event context, a slow or failed deposit is volume lost in real time. You’ve designed under that pressure, or you can show us you get it.
* **Data- and user-driven by default.** You instrument your own funnel, size the opportunity, and prioritize off the numbers without waiting for someone to hand you the analysis. You also go to the source, running your own research on how people sign up, verify, and fund, and letting what you learn reshape the roadmap. Both the quantitative and the qualitative.

### **Strong Plus:**

* **KYC / identity depth.** You’ve owned identity verification, step-up, or risk-tiered challenge decisions yourself. (If a peer owned KYC while you owned deposits, that’s fine, but identity fluency helps here.)
* **Regulated on/off-ramp or neobank experience.** You’ve sat at the intersection of compliance, rails, and consumer conversion.
* **Prediction-market, sportsbook, or real-money-gaming background.** You know why funding has to feel instant during a live game.
* **Deep design-tool / design-system fluency.** You move faster treating design as a peer discipline rather than a handoff.
* **AI-augmented product work.** You use AI tools with human judgment in the loop to move faster on research,

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

  

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.

  

**The Problem You'll Solve**

Something is always happening - a game, a vote, a number moving - and OG is where traders come to discover it and make their call. That’s the reflex we’re building: the surface should feel like it was built for this exact moment - every time someone opens the app, their obvious next step should always be acting on what’s happening right now.

You will lead merchandising for OG’s surface - deciding what’s featured, how it’s packaged, and how it evolves in real time. You bring the instincts of someone deeply in tune with sports, politics, and real-world events, paired with fluency in how a prediction market trades, to make OG’s surface feel current and alive at every moment.

You will operate with autonomy - proposing and making the calls on what’s featured, how it’s packaged, and what comes off the board - while working closely with Product and Market Liquidity and Operations to keep the surface moving as fast as the moment does.

### **What You'll Actually Do:**

* Own the merchandised surface end-to-end. You lead decisions on homepage / discovery modules and featured market placement across OG web and mobile - what sits in the hero, what rotates, and what earns its place. Every decision is made against one question: does this get tapped, traded, and come back tomorrow. You make decisions that offer the best commercial quality, working closely with Product along the way.
* Bring proven merchandising craft to prediction markets. You bring instincts for hero carousels, quick-pick modules, thematic tiles, and high-intent packaging, and translate them into prediction-market terms: multi-contract packages, correlated event bundles, and narrative-driven hubs that make trading on a moment feel as easy and exciting as it should.
* Build packaged, high-intent merchandising. You create and rotate packages tied to real narratives, and you package for liquidity and clarity so every trade is easy to understand and act on. You propose and make the call on what ships to the module, in step with Trading and Market Ops.
* Run live merchandising. You swap surfaces in real time during major events - games, elections, breaking news, viral moments. You partner with Market Liquidity & Operations when odds or liquidity shift. You stay calm when the calendar is nights, weekends, and holidays. Speed without sloppiness - you’re managing the public face of the product.
* Connect the calendar to the product. You own the calendar against sports, politics, culture, and market-moving news so launches aren’t a surprise to the homepage. You flag coverage gaps back to Market Ops before the story peaks.
* Make discovery exciting, not just functional. You treat the surface as the reason someone opens the app at all - fresh, current, a little addictive. You know the difference between a homepage that’s operational and one that makes someone want to check it again in twenty minutes.
* Prove it with experiments. You prioritize, QA, and read merchandising A/B tests with Product and Analytics against CTR, conversion, trading volume, and DAU/return-visit lift. You know when a test is invalid. You instrument your own funnel; you don’t wait for someone to hand you the analysis.
* Watch the competitive set and respond. You track competitors closely, and you propose responses, work with engineers and ship them.
* Handoff cleanly with Market Ops. You consume new listings the moment they’re live. You feed unmet demand and broken-resolution UX signals back. Market Ops handles the listing and settlement processes while you own the presentation of our customer-facing product interfaces.

### **Requirements:**

* Surface merchandising you've owned. You have owned sportsbook, iGaming, or marketplace merchandising (modules, features, packages) end-to-end, with a track record of improving engagement, conversion, or volume, and you adapt readily when things move fast and dependencies shift. We care what you've built and owned.
* Live / calendar ops under pressure. You operate comfortably on event time (nights, weekends, holidays), swapping and re-featuring quickly to keep the surface current as moments unfold.
* Data-informed, not gut-only. You are adept at defining success criteria and tracking them closely - using SQL, dashboards, or a partner analyst to decide what features, and reading what the data tells you against CTR, conversion, and volume/DAU impact. You make informed decisions and communicate the rationale with clarity so stakeholders understand.
* Experiment literacy. You design, run, and read A/B tests for merchandising or discovery with rigor, distinguishing valid signal from noise so winners and invalid tests are both handled with the same discipline.
* Cross-functional collaborator. You work closely with Product, Market Liquidity & Operations, and Marketing, communicating your decisions clearly, coordinating launches smoothly and adapting when the need arises.
* Domain fluency or fast learning speed. You're comfortable in both idioms - odds, parlays, and hold on one side; order books, contract pricing, and liquidity depth on the other - or you learn fast enough to engage power users credibly on both.

### **Preferred:**

* Sportsbook / iGaming merchandising. You have experience building and rotating homepage modules, parlay/SGP-style packages, and live in-game surfacing, with a craft for making a screen feel ur

jobs.title: Trust & Safety Product Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

We are hiring a Trust & Safety Product Operations Specialist to investigate safety incidents and work with the Product and Legal teams to prevent the next one. You will report to the Director of Trust & Safety. You will turn what cases and data show into product feedback and process fixes.

This role uses AI throughout. You will prompt it to query data and build tools, and you will answer for what it produces.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Investigations & Policy**

* Run safety investigations from intake through resolution. Weigh conflicting accounts against the evidence, and close each case with a written finding that a second reviewer can verify.
* Handle escalated tickets. Communicate clearly with professionals and partners, and with legal and law enforcement when a case requires it. Tie every resolution to the facts and to our terms.
* Apply Instawork’s Community Guidelines consistently, and propose revisions where cases expose gaps.

### **Data & Metrics**

* Use natural language to generate SQL for our databases. Review each query’s logic and verify its results before you act on them.
* Identify fraud patterns and safety trends yourself, without a technical intermediary. Report what the data supports and where it falls short.
* Track the metrics that show whether Trust & Safety is working, including incident rate, time to first action, appeal overturn rate, and repeat-violation rate. Report results to Product and Legal against targets set by the Director of Trust & Safety.
* Investigate the cause when a metric moves off target, and recommend a response.
* Re-review a sample of closed cases each month to check that findings are accurate and consistent.

### **Product Operations & Automation**

* Test new safety and enforcement features before launch, and send Product written defect reports.
* Help plan outreach to professionals and partners for each new feature, and track adoption from launch.
* Collect and analyze feedback from cases and support channels, and report what it implies for departmental and company planning.
* Build internal tools by prompting AI coding assistants. Check the logic and test the output before a tool touches a live case. Examples include scripts that assemble case evidence and workflows that route incoming reports. Keep data privacy and human review in each tool.
* Find the manual steps that slow investigations and replace them with automation or a tool you build. Maintain what you ship.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 1+ years in Trust & Safety, Operations, or Compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to weigh conflicting accounts and reach a fair finding under pressure, with a habit of checking your own bias.
* Daily professional use of AI to query data and build tools, and a working knowledge of where it fails.
* Fluency in Excel or Google Sheets, and comfort moving through internal systems to assemble facts.
* Experience tracking and reporting operational metrics, and judgment about which ones mislead.
* Ownership of each case until the underlying problem is solved.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* SQL, Python (Pandas), or a BI tool such as Looker or Tableau.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or Replit, or with no-code tools such as Zapier.
* Experience working with external stakeholders such as clients, legal teams, or law enforcement.
* Experience testing or launching product features.
* Background in a marketplace or labor platform.

  We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* **Always Be Learning**

Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada.
