jobs.title: Operations Manager - Memphis
jobs.description:
**WHY MILLCRAFT**  
At Millcraft, we’re more than a business, we’re a family. For over 100 years, we’ve been proud to serve the paper, packaging, and graphic arts industries, guided by our values of Family, Passion, Aspire, Responsible, and Deliver. We care deeply about our people, our customers, and our communities, and we believe in creating a place where you can grow, belong, and make a real difference. Come join us and be part of something truly special.

**THE DIFFERENCE YOU WILL MAKE**  
Reporting to the Director of Operations, the primary responsibility of the Operations Manager is to manage and oversee the day-to-day functions within the distribution center in establishing and maintaining efficient and effective processes in the flow of merchandise in and out of the facility. The Operations Manager is responsible to assure growth, diversification and learning among all Operations team members. This role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to optimize workflows, resources, and personnel to achieve operational excellence.  
  
**CORE FUNCTIONS OF THIS ROLE**

* Oversee all operational activities of the distribution center (DC) in order to manage and improve the flow of inventory in and out of the facility - includes receiving, picking, packing, shipping, transportation, and others
* Ability to manage a total operation to meet productivity and safety targets
* Train, coach, develop, and lead all employees to encourage professional growth and great performance. Provide feedback to employees to foster open communication and support retention of great employees
* Participate in the management of the DC budget and financials
* Collaborate on staffing levels and productivity in order to achieve and maintain a cost-effective operation
* Make recommendations to increase sales, decrease expenses and improve profitability
* Coordinate and communicate with other divisions and support departments and stores to ensure that the right product is in the right place at the right time
* Ensure that all loss prevention and security guidelines are followed
* Support and drive operational changes and build a “learning” culture
* Set expectations and hold team accountable for efficient and effective movement of inventory to ensure timely delivery and accurate inventory
* Participate in the annual performance evaluation process with input and suggestions for improved performance, skills gaps and opportunities for training, attendance, participation in and recognition of safety, and others
* Provide training for, oversee and maintain compliance with Millcraft’s safety procedures and OSHA guidelines. Participate in Millcraft’s annual Safety Summit. Ensure proper usage of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Assure all employees are trained in the use of all equipment
* Prevent workplace incidents and injuries through training, safe work standards, a clean workplace free from debris and litter, and others
* Participate in and/or oversee first reports of injury, investigations, assessing root causes, and implementing necessary improvements in support a safe work environment
* Engage with other division DC’s, stores, customer service and others to assure solid communication and collaboration in the movement of inventory along the supply chain
* Identify, address and providing solutions to logistical challenges and problems.
* Manage the company’s time and attendance system with regard to editing, auditing and approving non-exempt employees’ hours worked. Understands and complies with Department of Labor – Wage and Hour Division as communicated and managed by Millcraft’s Human Resources and Operations leadership team
* Support the effective use of Millcraft’s ERP system and provide training and retraining to all Operations employees
* Follow all Millcraft policies, procedures, and guidelines as outlined in the employee handbook and departmental SOPs
* Ensure a safe working environment by strictly following all safety protocols and standards including reporting unsafe conditions, near-misses and incidents immediately to your manager
* Demonstrate the Millcraft Core Values (Family, Responsible, Passion, Deliver, Aspire and FUN) in day-to-day work and interactions
* Other duties as needed for the business.

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Technically oriented - daily use of Microsoft Office including but not limited to Outlook, Excel, and Word. Warehousing – advanced warehouse systems highly preferred including RF
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to multi-task
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams to achieve performance goals
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
* Proven commitment to safety and wellness in the workplace
* Ability to travel
* Ability to lift up to 70 lbs. and participate in manual activities – for training purposes and other
* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Experience in a paper and/or packaging environment is preferred
* Proven experience in operations management, with at least 3 years of experience in a leadership role
* Ensure compliance with safety and company procedures, and actively embody our core values in every interaction and responsibility. (Include in all JD’s)

**WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE**  
This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee. They may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.  
  
**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift items that weigh a minimum of 70lbs regularly
* Ability to stand for long periods of time
* Ability to bend, stoop and climb repetitiously throughout the day

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

jobs.title: Multi-Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a highly capable, organized, and proactive professional to work directly with an entrepreneur who owns and operates multiple businesses across different industries and locations throughout the United States.

Our business interests include insurance, tax services, technology, professional services, media, and other developing ventures.

As our portfolio continues to grow, we are looking for someone who can help establish organization, coordinate operations, manage projects, and ensure important business initiatives consistently move forward.

This position combines elements of executive assistance, business operations, project management, and strategic coordination.

**We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions. We need a resourceful individual who can take initiative, solve problems, follow through, and take meaningful responsibilities off the business owner's plate.**

Key Responsibilities

**Multi-Business Operations**

* Help organize and coordinate operations across multiple companies.
* Establish centralized systems to track business activities, projects, and priorities.
* Ensure deadlines, deliverables, and business objectives are consistently followed up on.
* Assist with implementing processes that improve organization and efficiency.
* Identify operational problems and proactively develop solutions.

**Project Management**

* Turn business ideas and objectives into structured action plans.
* Coordinate new business launches, ongoing projects, and operational improvements.
* Track assignments and follow up with employees, contractors, and service providers.
* Research and coordinate resources needed to complete projects.
* Prepare progress reports and maintain visibility into active initiatives.

**Executive Support**

* Assist the founder with managing schedules, meetings, communications, and priorities.
* Organize important documents, business information, and administrative processes.
* Help manage email correspondence and follow-ups.
* Handle routine matters independently while escalating important decisions.
* Help the founder remain focused on growth, strategy, and high-level business decisions.

**Team & Vendor Coordination**

* Communicate with employees, managers, freelancers, and outside service providers across different locations.
* Track assignments, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Assist with hiring, onboarding, and coordinating personnel.
* Hold team members accountable for progress and completion.
* Improve communication and workflow between different businesses.

**Business Growth & Implementation**

* Assist with research, planning, and execution of new opportunities.
* Coordinate website, marketing, technology, and operational projects.
* Help implement new business systems, software, and automation.
* Assist with vendor comparisons, service sourcing, and other special projects.
* Help develop procedures that allow businesses to operate more independently.

Qualifications

* Experience in business operations, project management, executive assistance, or similar positions.
* Excellent organizational, multitasking, and communication skills.
* Strong independent problem-solving abilities.
* Experience managing multiple priorities, deadlines, and projects.
* Comfortable coordinating remote employees, contractors, and vendors.
* Proficient with modern business tools, project management software, and AI productivity applications.
* Ability to learn new industries and business processes quickly.
* Strong follow-through and attention to detail.
* Professional, dependable, and comfortable handling confidential business information.

Experience working directly with entrepreneurs, small-business owners, or multiple companies is highly desirable.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys making things happen.

You don't need every detail explained before getting started. You know how to research, organize, follow up, and find solutions.

You are comfortable working with a business owner who has multiple projects and ideas in motion and can help turn those ideas into organized, actionable plans.

You take pride in completing projects, keeping people accountable, and creating systems that make organizations run more efficiently.

Expectations During the First 90 Days

* Establish an organized overview of all active businesses and projects.
* Create a centralized project and task management system.
* Implement weekly priorities and progress reporting.
* Establish consistent follow-up procedures with employees and contractors.
* Take ownership of recurring administrative and coordination responsibilities.
* Demonstrate measurable progress on priority business initiatives.
* Reduce the amount of time the founder spends managing routine operations.

Growth Opportunity

This position offers significant growth potential. The right candidate may eventually advance into a Director of Operations or Chief of Staff role as responsibilities expand.

We are looking for a long-term professional relationship with someone who wants to play an important role in building and managing a growing portfolio of businesses.

How to Apply

Submit your resume along with a brief explanation of your experience supporting business owners, organizing multiple projects, or coordinating business operations.

Please include an example of a project or operational challenge you independently managed from start to completion.

Pay: $45,000.00 - $72,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Remote Dispatch Operations Manager (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are a premier black car and luxury transportation service looking for a high-energy, self-starting **Dispatch Operations Manager** to oversee our small remote dispatch team. This is a part-time, fully remote position that offers exceptional scheduling flexibility. If you are a friendly, people-first leader who thrives in fast-paced logistics, loves building up teams, and is obsessed with delivering a 5-star customer experience, we want to hear from you.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Team Leadership:** Supervise, mentor, and coach a small remote team of dispatchers to ensure seamless operations and flawless coverage.
* **Operational Oversight:** Monitor real-time fleet schedules, flight tracking, and booking flows to ensure zero missed trips or service gaps.
* **Performance Coaching:** Act as a hands-on leader by coaching dispatchers on client communication, problem-solving under pressure, and performance metrics.
* **High-Touch Customer Service:** Step in to handle high-value corporate client requests, escalations, or complex reservation logistics.
* **Drive Revenue:** Leverage your phone presence to assist clients with booking inquiries, turning incoming calls into confirmed premium reservations.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Management Experience:** Minimum of 3+ years of experience managing, supervising, or leading a team (transportation or logistics setting preferred).
* **Industry Experience & Software:** Previous experience in industry and using **Limo Anywhere** especially or similar chauffeured dispatch platforms is required.
* **The Right Personality:** You must be a naturally warm, energetic "people person" with an over-achiever mindset. You are a self-starter who doesn't need to be micro-managed.
* **Tech Literacy:** Strong comfort level with remote workplace tech (Slack, Zoom, shared sheets) and a quiet, distraction-free home office setup with high-speed internet.

**Bonus Points If You Have:**

* A proven track record in **inside sales, phone sales, or upscale hospitality**.
* Formal training or **coaching experience** (helping team members hit KPIs or improve customer service skills).

**What We Offer**

* **True Flexibility:** Work around your personal schedule with highly flexible part-time hours.
* **100% Remote:** Skip the commute and work from anywhere in the United States.
* **Supportive Culture:** Join an energetic, growth-minded environment where your impact is recognized and rewarded.

Pay: $15.00 - $20.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* 1) Scenario: Inbound quotes for premium multi-car or hourly requests are high, but our team's close rate is low. Clients frequently say "I'll think about it" and hang up.

Question: Given your phone sales background, how would you evaluate our current scripts? What baseline Quote-to-Booking Conversion Rate do you consider acceptable for luxury livery, and how would you coach a dispatcher who excels at logistics but struggles to close sales?

2) Scenario: I need a high-level view of how dispatch decisions hit our bottom line without digging into raw logs. I want a monthly breakdown of money lost to dispatch errors (like service credits for late pickups) versus fleet efficiency.

Question: What weekly/monthly data points would you pull from Limo Anywhere for an executive summary? How would you format it to highlight the Cost of Quality alongside metrics like Average Revenue per Trip?

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Benefits Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Reports To:** Chief of Staff, CPO’s Office  
**Location**: USA (Remote)

**About us**  
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

**Our people**  
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

**Our impact**  
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

  

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Benefits Operations Manager to own the delivery, optimization, and continued evolution of HighLevel’s benefits programs. Reporting to the Chief of Staff in the CPO’s Office, you’ll serve as the senior individual contributor responsible for ensuring our benefits experience is accurate, scalable, employee-centered, and operationally strong.

This role goes beyond administration. You’ll own day-to-day US benefits operations while helping shape our global benefits philosophy, strengthening vendor performance, improving service delivery, and building the processes, education, and infrastructure that make benefits easier for employees to understand and use.

The ideal candidate combines deep benefits expertise with strong operational judgment, a customer-first mindset, and a continuous improvement orientation. You know how to move between strategy and execution, translate complex benefits topics into clear guidance, and build systems that can scale with a fast-growing, globally distributed company.

  

**What You’ll Do**

* **Foundational Program Execution:** Own the full day-to-day administration of US health benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, FSA/HSA, 401(k), EAP, enrollments, qualified life events, terminations, COBRA, eligibility changes, and employee escalations.
* **Employee Benefits Support & Ticket Management**: Own benefits ticket intake, resolution, escalation, and trend analysis to improve service and reduce repeat issues.
* **Vendor & Carrier Management:** Own relationships with brokers, carriers, administrators, and benefits vendors, including performance, service levels, escalations, and ongoing improvement.
* **Global Benefits Strategy:** Partner with the Chief of Staff to develop and evolve HighLevel’s global benefits philosophy, evaluating programs across countries and employee populations for competitiveness, consistency, cost, and employee experience.
* **Global Benefits Education & Enablement:** Lead a year-round global benefits education program that helps employees understand and use their benefits effectively.
* **Well-Being & Perks Optimization:** Build, launch, and manage employee perks and well-being programs aligned with HighLevel’s overall benefits philosophy.
* **Design for Employee Experience:** Design benefits programs, communications, and service experiences that are intuitive, accessible, and easy for employees and managers to navigate.
* **Quality & Process Rigor:** Maintain clear benefits documentation, controls, ownership, and source-of-truth records so processes are accurate, repeatable, auditable, and easy to operate.
* **Continuous Improvement & Program Optimization:** Continuously improve the overall benefits program, vendors, processes, systems, and employee experience using data, feedback, and performance trends.
* **Executive & Employee Communication:** Translate complex benefits topics into clear recommendations for leaders and simple, human-centered guidance for employees.

  

**What You’ll Bring**

* **8+ Years of Benefits Experience:** Progressive experience in US benefits administration and operations, including ownership of complex programs, renewals, vendor relationships, and employee escalations.
* **Deep Benefits Expertise:** Strong knowledge of US health and welfare benefits, ERISA, ACA, COBRA, Section 125, HSA/FSA administration, and 401(k) operations.
* **Strategic & Operational Judgment:** Proven ability to evaluate complex issues, identify root causes, weigh tradeoffs, and make practical recommendations that balance employee experience, cost, risk, and scalability.
* **Vendor & Stakeholder Leadership:** Strong experience managing brokers, carriers, and benefits vendors while partnering effectively with Finance, Payroll, Legal, People Operations, and People Technology.
* **Systems & Process Mindset:** Experience improving benefits processes, controls, integrations, and service models rather than relying on manual workarounds.
* **Builder Mindset:** You’re energized by fixing what’s broken, building processes and infrastructure from the ground up, and leaving programs stronger, clearer, and more scalable than you found them.
* **Fast Learner & Collaborative Operator:** You

**Position Type:** Full-Time

jobs.title: Pharmacy Operations Optimization Manager – KitCheck
jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

The Pharmacy Operations Optimization Manager is responsible for the engagement health and realized value of Bluesight's KitCheck customer portfolio. KitCheck helps hospital pharmacies process kits and trays faster and more accurately with RFID, but the product only delivers value when pharmacy teams actively scan, keep their formulary and kit masters current, stay ahead on tag and consumable ordering, and use the data to run leaner operations. This role exists to make sure that happens across every account, not just the ones that ask for help.

You will own the full book of business at the cohort level: monitoring engagement and operational performance across all KitCheck customers, identifying accounts drifting toward disengagement before they become renewal risks, and directing the right resource (yourself, an Implementation or Support specialist, or a Customer Success Manager) to get them back on track. You will also build and run the reporting cadence that keeps our internal teams aligned, including a recurring executive summary and regular updates to CSMs on their accounts.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with hands-on experience in hospital pharmacy operations, ideally including kit and tray processing, medication inventory management, or pharmacy automation. A PharmD or CPhT credential is required. You can balance portfolio-level oversight with hands-on customer work, and you are comfortable being the subject matter expert in the room with a pharmacy director, an operations manager, or a buyer.

### **Core Responsibilities**

**Portfolio & Cohort Management:** Own engagement health across the full KitCheck customer base. Maintain a portfolio view of which accounts are actively working the product, which are drifting, and which need intervention, and make sure every at-risk account has a named owner and a plan.

**Engagement Metrics & Reporting:** Define and maintain the KitCheck engagement scorecard (e.g., scanning and kit processing activity, charge and restock turnaround, tag and consumable ordering trends, expired medication capture, active user trends). Publish a recurring executive flash summarizing portfolio health, and send regular account-level updates to CSMs so nothing surprises them at renewal.

**Proactive Account Intervention:** For accounts missing the mark, run the play: diagnose the gap, re-engage the customer directly or deploy the right internal expert, and establish recurring touchpoints (monthly calls, best-practice reviews) until the account is back on track.

**SME Capacity Orchestration:** Direct traffic for pharmacy SME capacity across Implementation, Support, and Professional Services. Proactively scope and assign timeboxed engagements (workflow reviews, kit master cleanups, operational tune-ups, re-training) against the accounts that need them most, alongside the existing CSM-initiated request channel.

**CS & Sales Enablement:** Arm CSMs and Account Managers with engagement and adoption context ahead of QBRs, EBRs, and renewal conversations. Flag accounts that are healthy enough for expansion conversations, and be honest about the ones that are not.

**Best Practices & Thought Leadership:** Develop and maintain the KitCheck Engagement Playbook covering cadences, intervention plays, and communication templates. Lead webinars and customer-facing content that raise the bar on pharmacy operations maturity across the customer base.

**Voice of the Customer:** Represent pharmacy workflow challenges, hardware and consumable friction, and adoption gaps to Product, Engineering, and Supply Chain, particularly where they affect renewal or expansion risk.

### **Qualifications**

**Education & Credentials**

* Bachelor's degree in pharmacy or a related field, or equivalent pharmacy technician experience.
* PharmD or CPhT credential required. Involvement in pharmacy practice communities (e.g., ASHP) is a plus.

**Experience**

* 5+ years in hospital pharmacy operations, including medication inventory management, kit and tray workflows, or pharmacy automation.
* Direct experience running or improving pharmacy operational workflows such as crash cart and tray processing, expiration management, and restocking cadences.
* Familiarity with RFID medication tracking, automated dispensing cabinets, and pharmacy information systems preferred.
* Experience in customer engagement, account management, or implementation within healthcare or hospital systems.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Proven ability to build credible relationships with pharmacy directors, operations managers, and technicians while delivering measurable value.
* Strong data analysis skills: comfortable defining metrics, reading engagement dashboards, and turning trends into intervention plans.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills for both customer-facing and executive audiences.
* Ability to manage a portfolio of accounts and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.

### **Why Join Us**

Hospital pharmacies are asked to do more with less every year, and manual kit and tray processing wastes pharmacist and technician hours that patients need elsewhere. In this role you will directly raise the operational effectiveness of medication kit management across a national portfolio of health systems while shaping how Bluesight scales proactive customer engagement across its product lines. jobs.title: Project Manager (Part-Time, HubSpot)
jobs.description:
**About the role**

AmplifyOps is a HubSpot implementation and RevOps consultancy based in Tulsa, OK, working with a portfolio of clients across associations, SaaS, media, and professional services. Our team of HubSpot admins, Service Hub specialists, data people, and developers does the technical work. We need someone who keeps that work moving and keeps clients informed.

This is a part-time Project Manager role, augmenting our staff on specific client projects. You own the schedule, the follow-ups, and the client relationship between calls. You should be comfortable working inside HubSpot day to day and know it well enough to understand what the team is building, ask the right questions, and explain status to a client without a translator. You don’t need to be a HubSpot wizard; the technical depth lives with our admins and developers.

The person who thrives here is organized, unflappable, and good in a room. Clients should feel calmer after talking to you, and the team should trust that nothing falls through the cracks.

**What you’ll do**

* Run 1-2 active client projects at a time: keep each one scoped, scheduled, and on track against the SOW
* Own client communication between meetings. Send recap emails within 24 hours of every call, with decisions, owners, and next steps
* Chase what’s outstanding. Follow up with clients on open requests, access, approvals, and content, and with our team on deliverables, without being asked
* Lead client status calls and kickoffs. Set the agenda, keep the room on track, and close with clear next steps
* Translate between clients and the technical team: turn a client’s request into a clear ask for our admins and developers, and turn their work into plain-language updates for the client
* Keep project tracking current in HubSpot and our internal tools (Supered, Slack, Google Drive, Clockify) so anyone on the team can see status at a glance
* Flag risk early. If scope is creeping, a deadline is slipping, or a client has gone quiet, raise it before it becomes a problem
* Support the weekly rhythm: internal project reviews, partner touchpoints, and end-of-week status summaries

**Must-haves**

* Hands-on HubSpot experience: you know your way around contacts, companies, deals, pipelines, workflows, and the Marketing, Sales, and Service Hubs well enough to follow a technical conversation, check on progress yourself, and explain it back to a client. Solid, not expert; the advanced build work is handled by our admins and developers
* The ability to task work clearly across all our resources. You turn a client need into a well-scoped assignment, matched to the right person (admin, Service Hub specialist, data, or development), with context, a definition of done, and a due date, so nobody has to come back and ask what you meant
* 2+ years managing client-facing projects, ideally at an agency, consultancy, or professional services firm
* A calm, confident presence with clients. You can run a call with a frustrated stakeholder, hold the room, and leave everyone clear on what happens next
* Clear, fast written communication. Your recap emails are short, specific, and go out the same day
* Relentless follow-through. You keep your own lists, nothing waits on a reminder from someone else, and you are comfortable nudging people (politely, repeatedly) until things close

**Nice-to-haves**

* HubSpot certifications (Marketing Software, Sales Software, Service Hub, or Reporting)
* Experience with RevOps, marketing operations, or CRM migrations
* Familiarity with Supered, Clockify, PandaDoc, or Zendesk
* Experience managing contractors or partner agencies alongside an internal team

**Details**

* **Hours:** Part-time, roughly 5-10 hours per week, with availability for client calls during US business hours
* **Location:** Remote, must be located in the USA.
* **Type:** Contractor. Part-time for now, augmenting our staff on specific client projects, with room to expand as the client base grows
* **Compensation:** $30-$40/hour, or a negotiated flat rate per project

Pay: $30.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 5.0 – 10.0 per week

* When is a company/contact qualified for deal creation in your opinion?

* Briefly describe the last HubSpot client/implementation/retainer you managed.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

**An overview of this role**

As the Manager, Global Partner Programs, you’ll turn GitLab’s ecosystem strategy into repeatable programs that help partners create value across the full customer lifecycle: Acquire, Commit, and Consume. You’ll own a portfolio of global partner program workstreams, such as partner sourcing, services attach, adoption, renewals, managed service providers (MSPs), global systems integrators (GSIs), hyperscaler, and marketplace motions, and make them clear, usable, and measurable for partners and sellers across regions.

This is a strategic individual contributor role. You’ll lead through expertise and influence rather than direct reports. You’ll partner with Ecosystem Sales, Partner Operations, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Enablement to launch and improve programs, recommend changes to incentives and policy, and connect program activity to pipeline, revenue, and customer outcomes. In your first year, you’ll focus on building a clear roadmap for your portfolio, simplifying partner requirements and rules of engagement, and setting up consistent reporting on program performance. As the team grows, this role may expand to include leading partner program managers.

**What you’ll do**

* Own the roadmap, priorities, and execution for an assigned set of global partner programs across Acquire, Commit, and Consume, within agreed strategy, policy, and budget.
* Coordinate requirements, milestones, owners, and risks across Ecosystem Sales, Partner Operations, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Services, Customer Success, Product, Enablement, and regional teams.
* Improve the partner journey from onboarding and capability building through activation, co-selling, adoption, and expansion, turning partner and field feedback into prioritized program improvements.
* Support the design and rollout of partner incentives, including margin, rebates, market development funds (MDF), deal registration, services attach, and consumption, and build business cases with Finance and Ecosystem leadership.
* Maintain program guides, eligibility rules, approval flows, and documentation, partnering with Legal and Finance so programs are compliant, auditable, and easy to understand.
* Create playbooks, launch materials, and training with Enablement and regional teams to drive adoption of new programs and commercial changes.
* Define success measures for each program, such as partner-sourced pipeline, services attach, adoption, and incentive use, and partner with Revenue Operations to report on them consistently.
* Use performance data to recommend investment changes, reduce exceptions and manual work, and escalate decisions that go beyond your scope.

**What you’ll bring**

* Experience in partner programs, channel strategy, alliances, ecosystem operations, or a related go-to-market function.
* A track record of taking complex programs from design through launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
* Understanding of partner economics, including incentives, deal registration, MDF, services programs, co-selling, and rules of engagement.
* Ability to lead global, cross-functional work without direct authority, setting clear owners, decisions, and escalation paths.
* Analytical judgment and the ability to connect program activity to pipeline, revenue, and customer outcomes.
* Strong written communication, including the ability to make complex commercial concepts simple for partners and sellers.
* Program management discipline across prioritization, dependencies, risk, and follow-through, with a bias toward practical execution.
* Familiarity with SaaS, cloud, DevOps, or AI partner ecosystems; consumption-based pricing; or hyperscaler marketplace and co-sell programs is a plus.

**Title:** Senior Project Manager

**Position Summary**

TW Powerline is an established electrical utility contractor specializing in high-voltage transmission and substation construction. We provide comprehensive EPC construction services for utility, renewable energy, and infrastructure projects, with a focus on safety, quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

jobs.title: Medical Leave Specialist – Documentation Quality Assurance (Remote)
jobs.description:
Job Overview

HealthSource Medical Associates is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented **Medical Leave Specialist** to join our growing remote healthcare team!

In this role, you will specialize in quality assurance and administrative coordination of medical leave and disability-related documentation, including Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) certifications, Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accommodation forms, short-term disability (STD) paperwork, and other medical certifications.

Your primary responsibility will be reviewing completed medical leave documentation for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and potential discrepancies before physician review and signature.

You will also coordinate corrections, clarifications, amendments, and additional documentation requests received from patients, employers, HR departments, leave administrators, and disability insurance carriers.

This is not a medical form preparation position. Our documentation team handles form completion. Your role will focus on quality review, case coordination, administrative follow-up, and ensuring documentation moves efficiently through the appropriate approval process.

The ideal candidate has experience in medical leave administration, disability claims coordination, or healthcare documentation review, along with exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

Duties

* Review completed FMLA, ADA accommodation, short-term disability, and other medical leave forms for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Identify missing information, conflicting dates, inconsistent leave frequencies or durations, incomplete responses, and potential documentation discrepancies.
* Cross-reference completed forms with available patient records, supporting documentation, and physician-approved information.
* Coordinate necessary corrections and clarifications with documentation specialists and physicians before forms are finalized.
* Review and process administrative follow-up requests from patients, employers, HR representatives, leave administrators, and disability insurance carriers.
* Coordinate requests for corrections, amendments, additional information, and documentation clarifications.
* Route requests requiring clinical judgment or changes to medical recommendations to the appropriate physician for review and approval.
* Monitor pending cases, outstanding corrections, and follow-up requests to ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain accurate case notes, communication records, and documentation updates within electronic health record (EHR) and case management systems.
* Communicate professionally with internal team members and external parties regarding documentation status and outstanding requirements.
* Identify recurring documentation errors and recommend improvements to quality assurance procedures and administrative workflows.
* Maintain strict patient confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA and applicable healthcare privacy regulations.

**Important:** This is an administrative quality assurance and coordination role. The Medical Leave Specialist will not independently determine medical eligibility for leave, modify diagnoses, establish medical restrictions, change leave recommendations, or make disability determinations. Clinical decisions and changes to physician-approved medical information must be referred to the physician.

Qualifications & Skills

* Previous experience in medical leave administration, disability claims, healthcare administration, medical records, or a related field.
* Strong familiarity with FMLA, ADA workplace accommodations, short-term disability, and medical leave documentation.
* Understanding of intermittent and continuous medical leave certifications, including leave frequency, duration, and certification periods.
* Exceptional attention to detail and ability to identify documentation inconsistencies and potential errors.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and case management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience coordinating with employers, HR departments, leave administrators, disability carriers, or healthcare providers.
* Proficiency with electronic health record (EHR/EMR) systems, case management platforms, and digital documentation tools.
* Knowledge of medical terminology and healthcare documentation practices.
* Understanding of HIPAA requirements and patient confidentiality.
* Ability to distinguish administrative corrections from matters requiring clinical review.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Previous employment as an FMLA Specialist, Leave of Absence Specialist, Disability Claims Specialist, Medical Documentation Specialist, or Medical Leave Coordinator.
* Experience reviewing medical certifications for completeness and consistency.
* Familiarity with third-party leave administrators and disability insurance carriers.
* Experience working in telemedicine, occupational health, disability management, or medical documentation quality assurance.

Why Join HealthSource Medical Associates?

HealthSource Medical Associates is a growing, physician-led telemedicine practice providing accessible, compassionate, and high-quality healthcare services.

As a Medical Leave Specialist, you will play an important role in ensuring the quality and reliability of medical leave documentation while supporting patients navigating workplace accommodations, medical leave, and disability-related processes.

We offer a collaborative remote work environment where accuracy, accountability, professionalism, and teamwork are valued.

If you have a strong understanding of medical leave processes, enjoy reviewing documentation, and take pride in ensuring accuracy and efficiency, we encourage you to apply!

**Join HealthSource Medical Associates and help us deliver exceptional patient-centered healthcare services!**

Pay: $15.00 - $18.00 per hou

### **About Cidi Labs**

Cidi Labs is a small but mighty company with a track record of providing innovative plugins for the Canvas LMS that over 600 educational institutions are using to enhance their online courses. We pride ourselves on our customer-first obsession and the huge amount of love our customers feel for our products and team. ### **Description**

**Quality Assurance Lead**
--------------------------

### **Overview**

We're looking for a QA Lead to own software quality across Cidi Labs products. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll lead the QA effort among our developers by setting testing standards, guiding how quality is built into each feature, and holding the bar for every release.

Success requires becoming a product expert. You'll need to understand our applications, customer workflows, and expected behavior well enough to spot gaps in requirements and validate releases with confidence.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own release quality and define the testing strategy and standards across all products.
* Partner with developers so new features ship with appropriate unit and integration tests, and identify and close coverage gaps.

* Work with Product, Engineering, and Business Analysts to improve requirement clarity and testability.

**Required**

* Experience with PHP, React, or JavaScript/TypeScript, and frameworks such as PHPUnit, Jest, Vitest, or Playwright.
* Experience with GitLab CI/CD and cloud-hosted SaaS applications.
* Knowledge of WCAG and accessibility testing.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Higher unit and integration test coverage across all products, backed by a lean E2E smoke suite.
* Fewer regressions and greater release confidence.
* Developers consistently owning quality for the features they build.

This role is performed primarily at a computer in a home or remote office setting. Join our team and be part of a dynamic and supportive environment where your contributions will make a meaningful impact on the success of our clients and the growth of our organization.

**About Trauma Healing Accelerated**

Trauma Healing Accelerated (THA) is an education organization built on the Biology of Trauma® framework developed by Dr. Aimie Apigian, a double board-certified physician and author of *The Biology of Trauma*. The framework explains how unresolved trauma is held in the body and nervous system, and how it can be addressed through a biology-first approach.

THA serves two audiences: individuals pursuing their own healing, and the coaches, therapists and clinicians who support them. Our programs include the self-paced 21-Day Journey, our flagship Foundational Journey, the Biology of Trauma® modules, yearlong programs for individuals and practitioners, and an online member community. All THA offerings are educational in nature and do not constitute medical advice.

The role leads the program management and support team, establishes delivery standards, and ensures participants complete their programs and progress to the next appropriate offering.

This is a systems-oriented leadership position. The Program Lead anticipates issues before they affect participants, resolves their root causes through improved processes, and protects the founder's time for teaching and content. **Continuation and retention**

* Guide graduates toward the most appropriate next program, in coordination with the growth team on timing and messaging.
* Own renewal and retention strategy for the yearlong programs and the practitioner network.

**Team leadership and operations**

* Lead the program managers, live session hosts, mentors and support staff responsible for program delivery.
* Develop and maintain the standard operating procedures, checklists and project management systems the team relies on.
* Establish a consistent weekly operating rhythm with clear priorities, ownership and status visibility.
* Identify and resolve quality issues before they reach the founder, and present decisions to her with options and a recommendation.

**AI and automation**

* Partner with THA's AI and web systems specialist to identify new opportunities to automate repetitive work, and review AI-generated content for accuracy before it reaches participants.

Performance in this role is measured by participant outcomes, satisfaction and retention.

* Completion rates for each program

* Participant satisfaction scores and reduction in avoidable support requests
* On-time launches and cohort starts free of access, link or communication errors
* A team that operates its responsibilities independently, reducing escalations to the founder

* Demonstrated experience managing online programs, courses, cohorts or membership communities.
* Experience leading distributed teams across countries and time zones.

* Experience building or managing automations and integrated systems, such as course platform workflows, email and SMS automation, or no-code tools like Zapier or n8n.

* Exceptional attention to detail and a rigorous approach to quality assurance.
* Clear, compassionate communication with participants and team members, including in sensitive situations.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to act on completion, continuation and retention data.

No prior experience with THA programs is necessary.

Apply through Indeed with your resume and a brief summary of a program or tea

jobs.title: Service Delivery Manager - Security & Governance
jobs.description:
AFC Industries is a dynamic organization dedicated to providing supply chain management solutions for fasteners and assembly components to original equipment manufacturers, assembly plants, and other users of these products.

We support a diverse industry base of manufacturers across a broad range of industries. Our experienced team has a proven track record of helping manufacturers and assemblers reduce cost, improve quality, and increase efficiency.

We are A Company Culture Devoted to Innovation & Improvement

AFC provides localized expertise to customers in particular industries and geographies. We don't have a traditional hierarchical management structure where everyone simply "reports up." Instead, our company is made up of on-the-ground experts operating in an entrepreneurial fashion with the backing and support of an enterprise-grade organization.

Sharing cultural values breeds consistency and quality throughout our organization. Collectively, we are committed to a simple management approach, which influences our company culture and our management style.

**AFC Industries**  
Reports to: Vice President of Information Technology  
Location: Remote

**Position Overview**
=====================

AFC Industries is seeking a Service Delivery Manager – Security & Governance to lead our cybersecurity & governance program across AFC Industries.

This service management role is responsible for cybersecurity operations and risk management while advancing AFC's CMMC 2.0 and ISO/IEC 27001 initiatives. The successful candidate will combine technical knowledge with strong leadership and communication skills to turn security requirements into practical, sustainable business processes.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Cybersecurity**
-----------------

* Lead AFC's cybersecurity strategy and roadmap, strengthen security controls, and coordinate priorities across internal teams and external security providers.
* Oversee security investigations and incident response, including containment, recovery, evidence preservation, escalation, and post-incident improvements.
* Oversee threat monitoring, vulnerability management, identity protection, endpoint security, and remediation efforts.
* Manage the performance and effectiveness of external cybersecurity providers.
* Lead employee security awareness efforts and report to leadership on cybersecurity posture, incidents, and remediation progress.

**Governance**
--------------

* Lead CMMC 2.0 readiness activities supporting Level 2 and applicable NIST SP 800-171 requirements, including CUI protection, assessments, documentation, and remediation.
* Lead the implementation and continual improvement of AFC's ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management System, including audits and corrective actions.
* Maintain the security risk register, assess third-party risks, and incorporate security requirements into projects, acquisitions, and emerging technologies.
* Develop, maintain, and oversee IT policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring clear ownership, regular reviews, and employee communication.
* Report to leadership on governance initiatives, compliance readiness, and outstanding risks.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Five or more years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, or IT governance, including program or team leadership.
* Experience overseeing security investigations, incident response, and external security providers.
* Working knowledge of CMMC 2.0, NIST SP 800-171, and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) protection.
* Practical experience implementing or maintaining an ISO 27001 Information Security Management System.
* Understanding of cloud, network, endpoint, and identity security, including Microsoft 365 and Azure environments.
* Experience with risk assessments, audit preparation, control documentation, and remediation management.
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the judgment to manage sensitive investigations and balance security with business needs.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience supporting CMMC Level 2 assessments and ISO 27001 certification.
* Familiarity with Microsoft GCC High, DFARS cybersecurity requirements, and acquisition integrations.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.

Experience in distribution, manufacturing, supply chain, or a geographically distributed organization

Salary Target 150-164k

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

*We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer.*

**Background Check Requirement**

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

**About Frontline Wildfire Defense**

Founded in 2017, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME's Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for "Most Innovative Housing Concept" and the Best of IBS Award for "Best Home Technology."

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We're building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

Every Frontline system is designed to protect a property even after its owners have evacuated. Our fire-tracking software alerts customers when a wildfire comes within ten miles and starts an automatic activation countdown. Each system has a connected controller with Wi-Fi, cellular, and satellite connectivity and a backup battery. When it activates, eave sprayers and roof rotors wet the home and up to 30 feet around it with water and Class A foam. When fire is close, customers need fast, calm, accurate help, and you will be responsible for making sure they get it at any hour.

This is a founding, hands-on leadership role. * Train and maintain a bench of cross-trained employees who can support the team during large or multiple simultaneous fire events.
* Manage schedules, timekeeping, overtime, and labor costs for an hourly team in compliance with federal and state wage and hour rules, including meal and rest breaks.

**Dementia Care Navigator – Remote Telehealth**

**Location:**  Remote (United States)

**Schedule:**  Flexible

**Pay:**  $25–$35 per hour

**About Harmonic Health**

The U.S. is facing an unseen challenge: millions of patients and families affected by Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and other neurodegenerative diseases. More than 7.4 million Americans age 65 and older live with Alzheimer's disease alone, and that number continues to grow.

Clinical experts, caregivers, and forward-thinkers founded Harmonic Health (HH) to transform the dementia care journey. As a participant in the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Guiding an Improved Dementia Experience (GUIDE) Model, our multidisciplinary care model blends telehealth, caregiver education, predictive analytics, and human-centered clinical support. We guide patients and families through every stage of dementia with compassion, dignity, and evidence-based care.

**About the role**

Harmonic Health is seeking an experienced Dementia Care Navigator (DCN) to join our growing, fully remote clinical team.

This role is central to the Harmonic Health care model. As the first and primary contact for patients and caregivers, you will build trusting relationships by telephone and video, complete GUIDE assessments, connect families with community services and respite support, and work closely with our nurse practitioners and clinical team. You will report to the Head of Clinical Operations.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience supporting people living with dementia or cognitive impairment and their caregivers, and is comfortable doing that work through telehealth. Harmonic Health provides GUIDE care navigator training and supports dementia certification so you can grow your expertise. You will thrive here if you enjoy a fast-paced, mission-driven startup and a collaborative, team-based approach to care.

**What you'll do**

Patient and caregiver engagement

● Serve as the first and primary point of contact for patients and caregivers at the Harmonic Health.

● Engage patients and caregivers during telephone and video visits, adapting your approach for people with memory loss, hearing or vision changes, or limited comfort with technology.

● Build and maintain trusting, supportive relationships with patients and caregivers over time.

● Provide social and emotional support to caregivers and help them identify practical solutions that reduce stress.

GUIDE assessments and care coordination

● Administer, score, and document validated GUIDE assessments for patients and caregivers in the required sequence.

● Screen for depression with the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) and for anxiety with the Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7).

● Measure caregiver burden with the Zarit Burden Interview (ZBI-22).

● Complete other required screens, such as home safety, health-related social needs, and functional status (activities of daily living).

● Address identified needs, and escalate positive or high-risk results, including any response that indicates thoughts of self-harm, immediately to the clinical team according to Harmonic Health protocols.

● Recognize changes in a patient's condition, behavior, safety, or caregiver well-being, and escalate promptly to the nurse practitioner or clinical team.

● Coordinate GUIDE respite services with partner home care and adult day providers.

● Help caregivers obtain services and benefits through advocacy, referrals, and follow-up.

● Identify community, state, and national resources, such as Area Agencies on Aging, support groups, and benefit programs.

● Schedule and coordinate visits and follow-up with patients, caregivers, and providers.

Patient and caregiver education

● Provide dementia and caregiver education, coaching, and training.

● Support shared decision-making and care planning with the clinical team.

Education and professional development

● Complete Harmonic Health GUIDE care navigator training and ongoing education.

● Participate in quality improvement and process improvement initiatives.

Collaboration

● Partner with physicians, nurse practitioners, behavioral health clinicians, and other team members on each patient's care plan.

● Participate in case conferences and clinical reviews.

● Build relationships with community agencies, senior living communities, and referral partners.

● Document all contacts, assessments, and referrals accurately and on time in the EMR.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

● At least 5 years of experience working with people living with dementia or cognitive impairment, older adults, or family caregivers, for example in memory care, assisted living, home care, adult day, hospice, or an Area Agency on Aging.

● Experience in care navigation, case management, care coordination, social services, or community outreach.

● Strong medical acumen with ability document medications.

● At least one of the following: CNA, LPN, RN, BSN, MSN, BSW, MSW, LCSW, or a dementia certification (CDP, CDCM, or CMDCP).

● Comfort supporting patients and caregivers through telephone and video visits.

● Willingness to obtain a dementia certification (CDP), if not already certified.

● Proficiency with EMRs, Microsoft Office, and other software.

● Ability to work 100% remotely.

**Preferred**

● Certified Dementia Practitioner (CDP), Certified Dementia Care Manager (CDCM), or Certified Montessori Dementia Care Professional (CMDCP).

● Experience administering standardized screening tools, such as the PHQ-9, GAD-7, or ZBI-22.

● Experience in a GUIDE program, Medicare care management, or remote care navigation.

● Bilingual in English and Spanish.

● Background in senior living, home health, home care, or adult day services.

● Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

● Comfort working in a startup and contributing to workflow development.

**Physical requirements**

● Frequent use of a computer, telephone, and telehealth syst

***Location:*** *Remote (U.S. based). This role supports Frontline customers in every market we serve and requires availability for rotating shifts, including overnights, weekends, and holidays. Candidates located in PST/MST time zones are preferred.*

**Background Check Requirement**

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

**About Frontline Wildfire Defense**

Founded in 2017, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. As a Wildfire Response Specialist, you will be part of Frontline's dedicated 24/7 response team, helping homeowners and commercial customers make sure their wildfire defense systems are ready, running, and doing their job when it matters most.

Every Frontline system is designed to protect a property even after its owners have evacuated. Our fire-tracking software alerts customers when a wildfire comes within 10 miles and starts an automatic activation countdown. Each system has a connected controller with Wi-Fi, cellular, and satellite connectivity and a backup battery. **24/7 Customer Support**

new_jobs.description:
**About Campfire**
------------------

Campfire is building modern accounting software for startups and mid-size tech companies, and we're going head to head with giants like NetSuite to do it. Our AI-native general ledger runs the close, revenue recognition, and reporting for finance teams that have outgrown QuickBooks and refuse to settle for a legacy ERP.

**The role**
------------

You'll own the business behind the business. You'll be the person leadership sends in on Campfire's highest-stakes problems, including ones nobody here has solved before. You'll get problems, not tasks, and you'll be expected to take them from "this is a mess" to "this runs itself." You'll work directly with every team at Campfire, and you'll have the authority to make decisions.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **The operating rhythm.** Help build and run the planning, goal-setting, and metrics cadence the company runs on. Make sure every team knows the number they own and whether they're hitting it.
* **The numbers leadership trusts.** Set the definitions for every core metric, then own the reporting for ARR, pipeline, bookings, retention, and spend. When the founders or the board ask a question, you have the answer, pulled straight from the raw data yourself.
* **Commercial contracts and vendors.** Run vendor negotiations and renewals, manage the contract lifecycle with legal, and make sure we never auto-renew something we don't need.
* **Sales and GTM operations.** Own CRM configuration, territory and quota planning, and the mechanics of how reps get paid. Make the sales team faster without letting the data get messy.
* **The company's infrastructure.** Insurance, office and real estate, compliance, and the systems that keep a growing company running. Nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.
* **Special projects that matter.** New market launches, partnerships, monetization and packaging work alongside our pricing lead, board prep. You'll take new initiatives from zero to one. When something important doesn't have an owner yet, it lands with you.
* **Automation over headcount.** If a process runs on spreadsheets and goodwill, rebuild it with code, AI, and the right tools so it scales without adding people.

**Who you are**
---------------

We care more about trajectory than pedigree. If you've owned hard problems end to end and have the results to show for it, we want to hear from you.

* **An owner, not a coordinator.** 2-4 years in business operations, top-tier consulting, banking, VC or PE, or founding a startup. You've been the person things roll up to.
* **Analytical to the core.** You're excellent in spreadsheets and you build models that hold up to scrutiny - you can tell the story behind the numbers.
* **AI-native in how you work.** You already use tools like Claude Code to automate work, build internal tools, and get more done than a team twice your size.
* **Commercially sharp.** You can read a contract, spot the bad clause, and negotiate a better deal with a vendor.
* **A clear communicator.** You can walk leadership or the board through a messy problem and leave them with a decision, and you're just as effective working alongside an AE or a support rep.
* **Relentless follow-through.** You close loops. When you say something will get done, it gets done, and people stop checking.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity.** Half of this job doesn't exist yet. You'll define it.

**Why this role**
-----------------

* **Direct line to leadership.** You work with leadership on decisions that move the business.
* **Breadth you won't find elsewhere.** Finance, sales, legal, and operations all cross your desk. It's a launchpad into leadership and the fastest path to running a business yourself.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

new_jobs.description:
**ORGANIZATION**

The mission of Ravenswood Family Health Network (RFHN) is to improve the health of the community by providing culturally sensitive, integrated primary and preventative health care to all, regardless of ability to pay or immigration status, and collaborating with community partners to address the social determinants of health.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Social Services Care Coordinator provides care coordination to patients served through the Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) and Health Care for the Homeless (HCH) programs and ECM programs. Under the direction of the Department Manager of Social Services, and in collaboration with the Senior Manager of Social Services and HCH Program Manager, the Coordinator supports patients experiencing homelessness, housing instability, alcohol dependence, and complex medical and social needs.

The Coordinator manages an active caseload of approximately 35 patients, completing assessments, developing care plans, coordinating services, conducting outreach, and connecting patients to healthcare, housing, benefits, and other community resources. The Coordinator works closely with the MAT and HCH teams to address barriers to care and social determinants of health while promoting patient engagement, self-advocacy, and independence.

The position utilizes trauma-informed, culturally responsive, patient-centered, motivational interviewing, and harm-reduction approaches and collaborates with internal teams and community partners to support coordinated care and improved patient outcomes.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*To be performed in accordance with RFHN Policies and Procedures*

* Serves as the primary contact to assigned social services members and advocates to help them navigate the healthcare system.
* Maintains an active caseload of approximately 35+ patients, providing ongoing social services care coordination based on patient needs, acuity, and program requirements.
* Completes comprehensive social service, psychosocial, and social determinants of health assessments to identify patient needs, strengths, barriers, risks, and available support systems.
* Develops individualized care plans in collaboration with patients, the MAT treatment team, Health Care for the Homeless (HCH) Program Manager, Senior Manager of Social Services, medical providers, behavioral health staff, and other members of the care team.
* Provides care coordination to patients participating in the Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) program with a focus on alcohol dependence, supporting engagement in treatment and continuity of care.
* Identifies ECM eligible candidates and refers them to Program Associate and covers for ECM cases as needed.
* Works collaboratively with the Health Care for the Homeless program to address the unique healthcare and social service needs of patients experiencing homelessness or housing instability.
* Provides patient outreach and engagement in clinic and community settings, including shelters, housing programs, and other locations where patients may be accessing services.
* Educates patients about housing resources, eligibility requirements, housing navigation processes, and available supportive housing and homeless services.
* Connects patients to appropriate housing resources, emergency shelter, transitional housing, permanent supportive housing, coordinated entry, and other community-based services.
* Identifies and coordinates referrals addressing social determinants of health, including housing, food insecurity, transportation, income, benefits, employment, legal services, behavioral health, alcohol dependence treatment, and other identified needs.
* Assists patients with accessing public benefits and supportive services, including SSI/SSDI, CalFresh, cash assistance, health insurance, and other available benefits.
* Assists patients with obtaining documents necessary to access housing, benefits, healthcare, and other services, including identification, birth certificates, financial documentation, and other required records.
* Supports patients with scheduling appointments, appointment reminders, transportation coordination, referrals, and other activities designed to reduce barriers to healthcare and treatment.
* Coordinates referrals and follows up with patients and service providers to promote successful connection to recommended services.
* Provides support during transitions of care, including hospital discharge, emergency department visits, residential treatment, alcohol dependence treatment, and transitions between healthcare and community-based services.
* Uses trauma-informed, culturally responsive, patient-centered, motivational interviewing, and harm-reduction approaches when working with patients.
* Educates and supports patients in developing self-advocacy, self-management, and independent skills to navigate healthcare, housing, and social service systems.
* Advocates for patients and assists in resolving barriers to healthcare, treatment, housing, benefits, and other needed services.
* Maintains regular communication with patients and, when authorized, family members, caregivers, guardians, or other identified support persons.
* Participates in interdisciplinary case conferences and collaborates with the Manager of Social Services, Senior Manager of Social Services, HCH Program Manager, MAT treatment team, medical providers, behavioral health staff, and community partners to coordinate patient care.
* Maintains timely, accurate, and complete documentation of assessments, care plans, patient contacts, referrals, interventions, and outcomes in Epic and other required systems.
* Maintains documentation and data necessary to meet RFHN, program, county, state, federal, health plan, and funding requirements.
* Identifies urgent or high-risk patient needs and promptly communicates concerns to the Manager of Social Services, Senior Manager of Social Services, HCH Program Manager, and/or appropriate clinical team member

new_jobs.title: Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
With traumatic brain injury, life changes in an instant. For us, there is no greater reward than easing human suffering and helping people put their lives back together. As a Case Manager, you will play a critical role in transforming lives and helping individuals regain their independence and quality of life.

At CNS, we are a community of "PATHfinders" who work together to find every path possible for our patients to reach their maximum independence and quality of life. We create a supportive work environment through selflessness, innovation, and hard work. We take work very seriously, but we also enjoy a great atmosphere of fun and professional development, and we are committed to promoting a rich environment for each other to thrive through collaboration and empowerment.

Pay Range: $80,000 - $95,000

**Responsibilities**

The Clinical Case Manager is concerned with and, under the supervision of the Director of Rehabilitation, responsible for the development, implementation and management of all clinical aspects of Centre for Neuro Skills. They are an integral part of the overall decision making process bridging both clinical and administrative matters involving both the clinic and residential sites. The six core components of clinical case management include: processes and relationships, health care management, community resources and support, service delivery, psychosocial intervention; and rehabilitation case management. Work is full time during the weekdays Monday- Friday from 7:30am-4:30pm and requires some on-call and overtime work.Your key responsibilities will include:

* Collects information about the patient’s situation and functioning to identify individual needs, and assessment of that information to develop a comprehensive case management plan.
* Plans the specific objectives, goals and actions designed to meet the patient’s needs. This plan should be action-oriented and time- specific. Establishes, communicates, and facilitates initial program issues and goals with appropriate designated staff.
* Communicates with external stakeholders and families to ensure coordination of services.
* Implements the specific case management activities and/or interventions that will lead to accomplishing the plan goals.
* Evaluates, at appropriate intervals, the plan’s effectiveness in reaching the desired outcomes and goals. This process might lead to a modification or change in the case management plan in its entirety or any of its components.

**Qualifications**

Successful candidates will have:

* **Passion for Care**: A deep understanding of the requirements for providing the type of care and supervision needed, including the ability to communicate effectively with them.
* **Leadership Skills**: The ability to recruit, employ, train, and evaluate qualified staff, and to make tough decisions when necessary.

**Experience and Education**

* **Specialized Knowledge**: CCM preferred. Successful completion of CCM required upon meeting eligibility guidelines. Demonstrate a capacity for and interest to absorb a global knowledge of medical and clinical rehabilitation aspects relating to traumatic brain injury. Experience in which supervisory abilities have been demonstrated.
